artifacts.summary: 6-phase, 6.5-hour sequential plan for measure-eager-context.sh: bash-modeled CLAUDE.md assembly prediction, @-import + volatile-file guard, corrected paths: glob-match rule derivation, machine-parseable output with --check/--write, manifest/doc registration, and baseline reconciliation.

memory_candidates.content: Bash glob-matching hazard for `paths:`-style frontmatter globs: inside `[[ str == pattern ]]`, bash treats `**` as a plain `*` regardless of `shopt -s globstar`, and `*` never crosses `/`. So `specs/**/*` silently FAILS to match `specs/000_x/reports/01_y.md` (3 segments). Any tool classifying rules or files by a `**`-bearing glob must translate the glob to an anchored ERE instead (`**/` -> `(.*/)?`, `**` -> `.*`, `*` -> `[^/]*`, `?` -> `[^/]`, escape `.`) and match with `=~`. The failure mode is silent under-counting, not an error.
